answer: Letterboxing club tenure with stamp collection record is the check: stamps collected across one moor for years. A farm faking 430 aliases needs 430 separate stamp records, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The pigment test is the price tag: 430 fakes mean 430 payments. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The knoll signal is visible to every grader, and the meadow ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
